Say this“If nothing on the menu jumps out, we can build a pasta exactly how you like it — pasta, sauce, and toppings, your call.”

A generous, butter-kissed rock lobster tail, broiled to perfection and served with silky whipped potatoes, grilled asparagus, and a rich sherry butter.

Say this“Our showstopper. It also makes a great add-on to any steak if someone wants surf and turf.”

Sparkling Wine, Ferrari 'Brut'

A French onion-style bone-in rib chop topped with caramelized onions, melted mozzarella, fresh sage, and a zippy jus.

Say this“It eats like a French onion soup and a pork chop had a baby — always a fun way to describe it to a curious guest.”

Pinot Noir 'The Calling' by Jim Nance

A 30-day aged, 18 oz bone-in USDA Prime ribeye.

Say this“This is the one for a guest who wants the richest, most marbled cut on the menu — the 30-day aging gives it real depth.”

Super Sardinian, Tanca Farra

Spiced deviled eggs, each topped with a crisp fried oyster, finished with a tangy remoulade and fresh chive. Creamy, crunchy and a little briny in one bite.

Say this“It’s a Southern classic with a twist: a creamy deviled egg topped with a crispy fried oyster. Rich, a little spicy, and a great one to share while you decide.”

Ferrari Brut ($20 glass) or Prosecco Ca’Bolani ($11)

Dietary / askContains egg and shellfish (oyster). Ask the chef what the oyster is breaded in and how spicy the egg is.

Slices of tart green tomato in a crisp cornmeal crust, served with Southern pimento cheese, sweet-tangy tomato jam and scallion.

Say this“Green tomatoes are firmer and more tart than red ones, so they stay crisp and tangy. The pimento cheese is creamy and the tomato jam adds a little sweetness. Easy to share.”

Sauvignon Blanc Yealands ($12) or Riesling Ars Vitis ($12)

Dietary / askCornmeal breading: not gluten-free, but okay for a gluten-sensitive guest (chef’s note). Contains dairy (pimento cheese).

Oxtail braised slowly with molasses until it falls off the bone, served over a smooth sweet potato purée with Southern collard greens. Deep, rich and a little sweet.

Say this“Oxtail is a rich, tender cut that braises for hours. The molasses gives it a deep sweet-savory flavor and the sweet potato purée is silky. It’s our most comforting dish on the menu.”

Merlot Decoy ($15) or Daou Pessimist red blend ($15). For a treat, Amarone Righetti ($22)

Dietary / askSweet potato is a purée (chef’s note). Collard greens are marked “not vegetarian”: confirm they are cooked with meat. Ask the chef about gluten and dairy in the braise.

Sweet South African lobster and tiger shrimp (about 5 oz of lobster and shrimp total) over creamy stone-ground grits with hatch chile and scallion. Our take on shrimp and grits.

Say this“It’s a play on shrimp and grits, with lobster. The grits are creamy and the hatch chile is mild, not spicy. If you don’t like shrimp, we can make it without.”

Chardonnay Sonoma-Cutrer ($16), or Vermentino ($12) for something lighter

Dietary / askMild, not spicy (chef’s note). Can be made without shrimp. Contains shellfish. Ask the chef about dairy in the grits.

Roasted airline chicken (a chicken breast with the first wing bone left on) with glazed carrots, English peas, celery root and potato, topped with golden puff pastry.

Say this“It’s the pot pie you grew up with, reimagined: tender chicken and vegetables under a flaky puff pastry top. Perfect for someone who wants something comforting.”

Chardonnay Ferrari-Carano ($15) or Pinot Noir Averæan ($16)

Dietary / askPuff pastry contains gluten and likely dairy. Ask the chef what the sauce is made with.

Bone-in veal chop with the long tomahawk bone, brined in apple cider for juiciness, served with mustard cream, asparagus and creamy butter beans.

Say this“The cider brine keeps it juicy and gives a hint of apple. The mustard cream adds a little tang. It’s the showcase dish on this menu.”

Pinot Noir Par Excellence ($18 glass). By the bottle, Vietti ‘Perbacco’ ($75). Chardonnay Sonoma-Cutrer ($16) also works with the cream

Dietary / askAsk the chef for the weight, the cooking temperature, and dairy in the mustard cream.

A light banana pudding mousse layered with Nilla wafer, drizzled with spiced rum caramel, and topped with chantilly (sweet whipped) cream.

Say this“It’s Southern banana pudding, made lighter as a mousse, with a spiced rum caramel. Comforting and not too heavy. Perfect to share.”

Moscato d’Asti ($11) or a Spanish Coffee cocktail

Dietary / askContains dairy, wheat (wafer) and likely egg. Ask the chef whether the caramel has alcohol cooked off.

Classic pecan pie with toasted pecans and brown butter, served with bourbon crème anglaise and maple vanilla ice cream.

Say this“It’s warm, nutty and sweet. The brown butter adds a toasty flavor and the bourbon crème anglaise ties it together. A real Southern finish.”

Leonardo Da Vinci cocktail (Yellowstone bourbon, amaretto), Spanish Coffee, or Espresso Martini

Dietary / askContains tree nuts (pecan), dairy, wheat and egg. Always ask about nut allergies.
